page_title: MNT 0-0 LIL | Montpellier v Lille 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The match has just finished.
90+2' Adam Ounas (Lille) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though.
90+2' Total attempts – 12:10.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
86' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
86' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take the corner.
84' Substitution. Angel Gomes will be replaced by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille).
84' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to substitute Christopher Jullien and he is replaced by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier).
83' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) has a goal ruled out for offside!
83' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
81' Benjamin Andre (Lille) plays a long ball to Edon Zhegrova, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
79' Lucas Chevalier pulls off a great save to deny Silvan Hefti (Montpellier), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
79' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
76' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Jonathan David will be replaced by Yusuf Yazici (Lille).
76' Adam Ounas (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gabriel Gudmundsson.
75' Angel Gomes (Lille) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
75' Ismaily (Lille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
73' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
72' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:9.
72' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

72' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
69' The opposition back off Edon Zhegrova (Lille) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky!
68' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
66' Yellow card. Tiago Santos (Lille) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
64' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) replacing Lucas Mincarelli.
64' Wahbi Khazri will be replaced by Axel Gueguin (Montpellier).
64' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.
62' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
61' What was Teji Savanier (Montpellier) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends a long ball in, but Lucas Chevalier comfortably gathers the ball.
51' Montpellier seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

50' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
47' Jonathan David (Lille) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
46' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) comes on the pitch for Arnaud Nordin.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
45+1' Great chance! Akor Adams (Montpellier) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post.
45+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Ismaily (Lille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
42' Ismaily (Lille) trips an opposition player and Hakim Ben El Hadj signals a foul.
40' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will deliver the corner kick.

40' Lucas Chevalier makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Joris Chotard (Montpellier) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the top left corner.
38' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
38' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to Montpellier.
38' A cross from Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
37' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
37' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
34' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
33' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
32' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) blows a big chance to score after blasting the ball under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. Now Montpellier have a corner.
31' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj has finally had enough of Paulo Fonseca and brandishes a yellow card at him!
30' The game is interrupted as Jonathan David (Lille) is flagged offside.
29' Flag goes up against Akor Adams (Montpellier) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes a direct free kick.
29' Ismaily (Lille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj had an easy-decision to make.
26' What a big chance! Jonathan David (Lille) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
26' Jonathan David (Lille) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
25' Angel Gomes (Lille) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
23' Angel Gomes (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Angel Gomes (Lille) does well to meet a cross from Edon Zhegrova, but he directs his shot just wide of the right post.
21' The linesman raises his flag. Ismaily (Lille) is adjudged offside.
20' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
20' Angel Gomes (Lille) sends a lovely cross into the penalty area and Gabriel Gudmundsson attempts to score after getting on the end of it.
18' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
17' Jonathan David (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Tiago Santos (Lille) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
15' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
13' Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Akor Adams (Montpellier).
13' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
11' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
11' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) sends an accurate short pass. Arnaud Nordin controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
9' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) sends a cross in and finds Jonathan David inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
6' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is able to continue to play.
6' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) makes a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Montpellier are ruled offside.
4' Half-chance! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) plays a pass into the box, but Lucas Chevalier reacts well to snuff out the attack.
3' Benjamin Andre (Lille) plays a terrific long ball forward to Edon Zhegrova, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
2' The Montpellier players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has started.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
